yuinsk.text: YuiNSK is all sharp edges: matchup rating near the top, bravery and resistance both sitting near the top, and a cadence that never drops. The accuracy sits near the top, with headshots close behind, and the lifetime numbers match the matchups stride for stride. A player who turns up sharp in every fight, whatever the opposition.

youhavebeenkickedfromtheserver.text: YouHaveBeenKickedFromTheServer arrived a day ago and already plays at the highest level: ranks near the top of the board over nearly every measure, sharp of aim, and calm as fights harden. The headshots keep landing, and the form softens against the strongest third too. Early days still, though the opening is already loud.

yuinsv.text: YuiNSV plays a swift, high-volume game: first-rate on every line, and a blistering output. Bravery runs near the top, so the output holds up against stronger enemies. Sharp aim, and headshots account for a strong slice of the attempts. The consistency mark sits below average, the lone blemish on an otherwise strong record.

yuokilerdestroyer.text: YuOkIlErDestroyer plays at full sprint: sitting top shelf, with pace at the ceiling and fearless all the way through. The output holds firm as the opposition gets stronger, while the headshots land near the very top. A complete game, played without a single wasted motion.

yuokilerdestroyeremerald.text: YuOkIlErDestroyerEMERALD never backs down: bravery sits at the very peak, the adjusted rating rides high, the tempo never drops, and the staying power keeps up. The output is furious, the aim is deadly, and a healthy share of the shots land as headshots. The lifetime numbers agree, placing the career in the top ranks, and consistency holds in the middle.

younglingslayertr.text: YounglingSlayerTR fights at full tilt: a furious kill pace, activity to match, and a matchup rating near the top. The bravery rises as the enemies get tougher, the aim stays precise, and the headshot share lands near the top. Consistency dips low against the strongest third, and the opponent sample here is older and thinner — so read this one as a rough sketch, not the finished picture.

younglingslayersprotocoldroid.text: YounglingSlayersProtocolDroid plays at a blistering clip: the kill pace sits among the very best tracked, backed by top-rank activity, bravery, and resistance. Precise aim, frequent headshots, and the lifetime record backs the matchup picture. Against the strongest third, the edge softens to mid-pack — the one wrinkle in a first-rate card.

youyun.text: Youyun wins the long game: a matchup rating near the very top, a matchup kill-death ratio among the best tracked, and resistance that scarcely yields against the strongest opposition. Pace sits well above average while the aim stays middling, yet the results stay elite, which says the timing and judgment carry the day. A player who makes every fight count.

y9k.text: y9k runs a complete, high-pressure game: the rating leads a full house, with tempo, bravery, and resistance all landing in the upper tier, and the matchup kill-death mark sitting there too. The headshot share is top-shelf while raw accuracy stays middle of the pack, so the damage comes from placement rather than volume. The lifetime board rates them a notch below the matchups, which still leaves a fearsome profile.

yuokilertr.text: YuOkIlErTR brings relentless pressure: tempo and bravery set the pace in the upper tier, resistance close behind; the matchup kill-death mark keeps up too. Consistency stays above average, so the game holds its nerve against the strongest third, and the headshot share sits top-shelf. The lifetime numbers agree, landing in the upper tier alongside the matchups.
